uncertainty.method: a delete-one-episode jackknife of the cell's position-weighted KL (and of its contribution to each objective), t with n - 1 = 10 degrees of freedom; the Kish effective count is reported beside it; no normal approximation over positions
uncertainty.interpretation: a FINITE-SAMPLE SENSITIVITY ANALYSIS over 11 clusters, four of which carry 78.7% of the positions; its interval is never read as a confidence interval with adequate coverage, and 1,063 positions are never treated as independent observations

decision_boundary.ranking: the candidate ranking rule is unchanged
report_beside_every_ranking: each objective as defined (equal-domain mean, worst domain, critical-token KL)
each objective with this cell left out (the tool sub-type pooled over the other six categories' positions; nothing else reweighted)
for the Top-1 against each state it is compared with (the Pareto front and the runner-up), the cell's contribution to their difference with its jackknife 90% interval
decision_boundary.flag: SENSITIVE_TO_THE_LIMITED_CELL when leaving the cell out changes the Top-1 or the Pareto front, OR when a key margin (the Top-1's margin over the runner-up or a front member on any objective) falls inside the uncertainty range of the cell's contribution to that difference
decision_boundary.consequence: a flagged Top-1 is NOT promoted as a reliable Top-1 without further independent validation (follow_up_validation)
decision_boundary.retention: every candidate checkpoint and every raw result is kept; no unfavourable candidate is deleted after the fact and no metric is redefined

follow_up_validation: re-score the retained Pareto front on a later suite version with full coverage when a compliant, admitted source supplies it (the search keeps the front's states; re-scoring is a forward pass, not a new search)
the trained students' formal measurement reads eval-set-1 (P10.3), where tool calling is reported as its own unit; it never selects a state
closed-loop tool success belongs to a registered tool evaluation (eval-set-2), not to teacher-forced KL

suite_check_after_generation: once the hybrid generation ends, the WHOLE state_eval suite gets one identity, coverage and freeze check: every other cell must meet its v2 requirement (positions and >= 5 tasks), or the suite does not freeze; the conditional registration of this one cell admits nothing else
